Features

Everything a daily practice needs.

Affirmations written for your goals, voiced in a calm read over classical art, a ritual you speak along with, and a voice you choose, even your own.

A voice you choose

The voice that reads to you

Choose the voice that reads your affirmations, from five calming narrators in every language. Or record a short sample once and let Falia speak every line back in your own voice. It is the feature the whole category is missing, and the one your brain believes most.

  • Five calming voices in every language, one free
  • Record once and hear every affirmation in your own voice
  • Your recordings stay private to you
  • Delete your voice at any time

A painted library

Affirmations over classical art

Every playlist pairs a curated public-domain painting with affirmations written for one area of life, voiced in a warm, unhurried read. Browse by money, love, career, confidence, health and peace.

  • Playlists across the life areas that matter
  • A different classical painting on every cover
  • A calm, professionally voiced read
  • Six free playlists to start, one per life area

Today & daily practice

A ritual, not a feed

Today opens on one daily moment: an affirmation over a painting, ready to play. The daily practice moves through today's lines one at a time, and a gentle streak keeps the habit.

  • One breathtaking daily moment on Today
  • A full-screen practice you speak along with
  • A low-pressure streak that keeps the ritual
  • A daily reminder at a time you choose

Listen your way

Made for morning and for sleep

Play a playlist over soft background ambience, set a sleep timer, and let it loop all night. Falia follows your system theme, Dawn or Night, or you choose.

  • Soundscapes layered softly under the voice
  • Sleep timer and all-night looping
  • Background and lock-screen playback
  • Dawn and Night themes, in your language

Yours, and private

A calm space that is yours

Your streak, your voice and your playlists live in a profile that is private to you. Change your name, language and theme whenever you like, and delete everything in a tap.

  • Your space
  • In daylight
  • Made for you
  • A playlist

Ready when you are.

Falia launches soon on the App Store and Google Play, in four languages.
